cand.title: Triathlon de Nyon / FISU
cand.excerpt: Event dates 2026-08-08 to 2026-08-09 are past at 2026-11-16; no future edition is dated in the stored research, so none is invented.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Olivier Mouraux is named for “Logements” in the 2026 WUC-specific organization chart: strongest accommodation-path contact. Yannick Grivel is president and is independently identified as OC President in the final bulletin: senior relationship and referral contact. Their roles support approaching them but do not prove hotel-contract signature authority or continuing 2027 housing responsibility. Leah Bonga, Team’s delegate, is a supplementary delegation-operations contact, not an established hotel buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Swiss Triathlon officially publishes 7–8 August 2027 for Triathlon de Nyon in its PROVISIONAL 2027 calendar. The calendar explicitly warns that dates may change. This is within the requested horizon, but is not a final organizer-confirmed date/venue package: the organizer homepage still displays 2026, and no edition-specific 2027 venue commitment was found. No next Nyon FISU championship edition was announced in the sources reviewed; FISU recurrence must not be attached to Nyon automatically. No confirmed Nyon edition dates through June 2028 were established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: geographically credible sports lodging in Founex for Nyon/La Côte, rather than downtown Geneva congress housing. A deliberately scoped 20–120-room team/official/club block could fit the hotel’s commercial band, but this is a sales design, not published demand. Six meeting rooms could support briefings and meals subject to operational validation; the race itself requires Colovray, not a hotel meeting venue. The 2026 official hotel-to-Colovray shuttle arrangement demonstrates that off-site, transported accommodation can work for this event, but proves neither a YOTEL booking nor its transfer time. Resort amenities are not a proven mandatory procurement criterion; YOTEL should not claim equivalent training/recovery facilities without checking requirements.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical 2026 competition venue: Centre sportif de Colovray / Colovray Sports Centre, Route de Genève 37, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. This is Nyon / La Côte, in the hotel’s primary territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. It is a sports venue, not a competing hotel. The 2027 calendar names the event but does not establish its exact venue. Everness was the 2026 FISU accommodation commitment, not the race venue.
findings.historicalRotation: Local Triathlon de Nyon: 9–10 August 2025 at Colovray; 8–9 August 2026 racing at Colovray, with the FISU opening ceremony on 7 August. The local organizer describes an annual event; this is not evidence of a rotating local destination. Separate FISU championship timeline: Nyon 7 August 2016; Kalmar, Sweden 1–2 September 2018; Maceio, Brazil 9–10 September 2022; Gdansk, Poland 30–31 August 2024; Nyon 8–9 August 2026. FISU describes a worldwide biennial championship. This selected published history does not establish a future Nyon award or historical hotels outside 2026.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Every hotel identified on the reviewed event accommodation pages: (1) Hôtel Everness / Everness Hotel & Resort — edition-specific official 2026 FISU accommodation. The accommodation page states, “All delegations will be accommodated at the Hôtel Everness”; final Bulletin #4 says, “All rooms have been booked for the duration of your stay.” Bulletin #1 describes an organizing-committee package covering accommodation, meals, airport/station transfers and local transport for 5–10 August 2026, at EUR 80 per person per night, with EUR 120 for additional officials or extended stays. These are package prices, not room rates. (2) The Bowling Hotel, Signy — the local triathlon access page states, “Notre partenaire, The Bowling Hotel, se réjouit de vous accueillir”; the 2026 homepage promotes advantageous rates. This is a lodging referral/partner promotion, not proof of a contracted room block. No separate housing bureau, lodging RFP, room allotment or future hotel selection process was identified. The published stand/food-truck tender is not a hotel RFP.
findings.organizationStructure: The Nyon Triathlon organizing committee is described as a nonprofit voluntary association, not a commercial PCO/DMC. The Swiss University Sports Federation hosted the 2026 championship through that committee under the FISU championship framework. FISU is distinct from the local organizer; Colovray is the sporting venue and Everness the accommodation provider. No appointed PCO, DMC or accommodation agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2026 FISU delegation lodging was already placed at Everness; final documentation says the rooms were booked. The Bowling Hotel also has a local-event partner referral position. No published hotel sell-out, overflow requirement, displaced demand, competing room-block quantities, exclusivity duration or 2027 renewal terms were found. Participation totals cannot be converted to guestrooms. There is no evidence that YOTEL can capture all delegates or fill its 237 guestrooms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Yannick Grivel via info@trinyon.ch and request an introduction to Olivier Mouraux, named 2026 accommodation lead. Ask them to confirm 2027 dates/Colovray, who now handles lodging, whether Everness or The Bowling Hotel rights extend to 2027, and whether teams/officials/club visitors need organizer-controlled blocks or direct-book rates. Offer a conditional 20–120-room concept with twin-room availability, secure bike storage, early breakfast, laundry, briefing space and a costed Colovray shuttle only after feasibility checks. Request actual 2026 overnight pickup and 2027 requirements before pricing or forecasting. Treat this as relationship development pending qualification, not an RFP response.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 16 November 2026, the 8–9 August 2026 races, 7 August opening ceremony and 5–10 August delegation stay programme are past. There is no remaining current-edition booking opportunity. The historical FISU delegation allocation was committed to Everness, not open sourcing. The provisional 2027 local race is a separate future prospect with unknown lodging access.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue the recurring local triathlon’s future lodging partnerships, club/team groups or officials support, conditional on confirmation of dates, venue, incumbent rights and actual overnight needs. The provisional 7–8 August 2027 listing is a tangible planning lead, not evidence of an open block. Do not market a recurring annual Nyon FISU championship: FISU rotates internationally and no next Nyon award was established.
